Aircond Service

General servicing for a unit that is still running but no longer performing. We inspect, clean and correct what we find, then test it before we leave.

We handle:

  • Cooling that has quietly dropped off
  • A unit that has never been serviced
  • Musty smell on start-up
  • Bill climbing with no change in use

Aircond Repair

Fast and reliable repair for all types of aircond issues. We diagnose problems and fix them correctly the first time.

We repair:

  • Will not start, or trips the breaker
  • Water dripping from the indoor unit
  • Rattling, grinding or buzzing

Aircond Repair

Which Aircond Service Do You Need?

Most people call about a symptom rather than a service, and that is the right way round. Weak cooling can be a dirty coil, a low refrigerant charge or a failing capacitor, and those are three different jobs.

Tell us what the unit is doing — how it sounds, when it started, whether it cools at all — and we will tell you which service fits before anything is booked. If it turns out to be the cheaper job, that is the one we will quote.
